summary: Compositing and layers received reliability fixes across CSS zoom, process and pipeline tracking, browser-parent lifetime handling, and compositor assertions. Android WebGL can now use SharedSurface_AndroidHardwareBuffer, improving hardware-buffer sharing, while APZ (asynchronous panning and zooming) now handles overscroll animations and overscroll-behavior more consistently across fling handoffs. Instrumentation for SVG and blob images also makes image activity easier to measure and tune.
